UF₆ is a gas, toxic and corrosive. Only Pressurized Conduits and a PVC-lined Pressurized Cylinder hold it: Gas Cartridges, Jetpacks, the Gas Reservoir, the Quantum Tunnel and the Flare Stack refuse it.
- Line a cylinder by using 4 PVC Sheets on it; it keeps its lining when broken.
- UF₆ carries its U-235 assay, shown in its name. Tanks and conduits never mix two assays: a cylinder of 4.5% won't take natural UF₆, and conduits of different assays don't join.
